dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: Adjustments can still be made to the new delivery plan's transfer point...

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: Oh, forgive me. Can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you muttering to yourself about?

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: It's complicated... I'll try to give you a summary.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: I work for the Communications Office, and my job is to evaluate and optimize transport plans for designated routes.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: Even if the Communications Office is well-staffed, covering all the transportation work throughout Liyue is quite impossible, which is why we outsource some work to the local Secure Transport Agencies.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: But given how their equipment varies, controlling the transportation times with any precision is a nightmare.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: This, in turn, poses a considerable challenge to our planning capabilities...

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: A situation like this will be difficult to turn around in the short term. After all, standardizing their equipment requires a huge investment.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: Local Secure Transport Agencies are usually unable to afford such large sums. They still have to live and eat, right? So, it's up to us to eke a solution out somehow...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Transportation proposal?

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: Take this for example. Agency A must transport goods from Lumidouce Harbor to Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: During this process, they transport the goods to the docks between Qiaoying Village and Qingce Village...

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: They can choose to transport the goods and carts to the opposite shore and continue on land.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: Now, you may have realized that continuing south along the waterway before getting on land at Wangshu Inn is the superior option!

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: But things aren't that simple. The ship traveling down the waterway may not belong to Agency A. It may belong to the Communications Office, Agency B, or independent shipowner C.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: In moments like these, specialized personnel are required to coordinate the transfers between different individuals or organizations. That is the transportation plan I mentioned.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good luck, and farewell!

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: Th—Thanks for the words of encouragement! I'll have to give it more thought...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like a lot of trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: Oh, it can't be helped. Getting various groups to cooperate has always been complicated.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: What I mentioned earlier was just the basics. Accounting for the type and time sensitivity of each shipment makes this a dizzying task and then some.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: Let's say the grain output in Chenyu Vale isn't looking good and a large import is required. This would occupy a large part of the transportation capacity available from Liyue's heartlands to Chenyu Vale.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: But the main export commodity here is tea leaves, and its weight characteristics, packing methods, and storage conditions greatly differ from grains.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: Fortunately, my seniors have resolved that issue a long while back. If I had to optimize the transportation of grains and tea leaves...

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: My hair would turn completely white within the week!
